testcase.name: devolution
testcase.system-out: Devolution of sale deed On the perusal of the Sale Deed dated 12-Feb-2015, it appears that the said Prakash sold, assigned and conveyed all that piece and parcel of the Land bearing Survey No. 111/1A admeasuring about 1200 sqft. situated at Village Aiyur village, Taluka Ariyalur, District Ariyalur to and in favour of Kumar vide Sale Deed dated 12-Feb-2015 registered at Serial No. 994 of 2015 before the SRO Aandimadam. Devolution of EB receipt Electricity Bill Receipt number 08231 dated 05-Aug-2025 for the property at Survey No. 111/1A, situated in Aiyur village village, Ariyalur taluk, Ariyalur district, stands in the name of <OWNER_NAME>. Devolution of EB patta On perusal of the Patta 1046 dated 12-Feb-2015, issued by Tahsildar Ariyalur, the property comprised in Survey No. 111/1A for an extent of 1200 sqft stands in the name of Prakash. Devolution of EC of Sale Deed On perusal of the EC of Sale Deed dated 12-Feb-2015, it appears that the said Prakash sold, assigned and conveyed a property admeasuring an extent of 1200 sqft comprised in Survey No. 111/1A situated at Village Aiyur village, Taluka Ariyalur, District Ariyalur, to and in favour of Kumar vide Sale Deed dated 12-Feb-2015 registered at Serial no. 994 of year 2015 before the SRO Aandimadam. Devolution of Mortgagae Deed On the perusal of the Mortgage Deed dated 17-Sept-2025, it appears that the said Prakash mortgaged all that piece and parcel of the Land bearing Survey No. 111/1A admeasuring about 1200 sqft. situated at Village Aiyur village, Taluka Ariyalur, District Ariyalur to and in favour of Kumar vide Mortgage Deed dated 17-Sept-2025 registered at Serial No. 177 of 2025 before the SRO Aandimadam.
